value.rationale: Fixed-point cardinality \(p^2\) conflates the nonisomorphic types \(C_p\oplus C_p\) and \(C_{p^2}\). Counting the canonical elementary subgroup \(A[p]\) is a natural type-resolved statistic for automorphisms of finite abelian p-groups. The exact formula, including the boundary exception at \(b=2\), is a reusable refinement of cardinality-only data.
